formulas.formula: Plan any party: budget, guests, shopping and the big day.
Event: the occasion, date, budget and how many adults and kids you expect.
Budget: venue, food, cake, decorations, entertainment... estimate first, then actual.
Guests: families with adults and kids, RSVP, gifts and thank-yous. The head count updates itself.
Shopping: set amounts per adult and per kid. Quantities grow or shrink with your head count.
To-Do and Day-Of: tasks counted back from the party, and the plan for the day.
Yes + Maybe + Pending guests are counted, so you never run short.
2 drinks per person and 1.5 plates per person is a good start.
Type how many come in a pack. The sheet rounds up to whole packs.
Keep 10% of the budget for last-minute things.

=IF(R5<0,"Over budget by "&TEXT(-R5,"$#,##0")&". Trim the Budget or Shopping list.",IF(R7>0,R7&IF(R7=1," to-do is"," to-dos are")&" overdue.",IF(R10>0,R10&IF(R10=1," payment is"," payments are")&" due soon.","All on track. Let's party!")))
Used until you fill the guest list.
=IF(COUNTIF('Guests'!$B$6:$B$105,"?*")>0,"From your guest list (Yes + Maybe + Pending).","From your estimate above.")
=IF(R13="","Add a date",IF(R13<0,"It's over. Hope it was fun!",IF(R13=0,"Today!",R13&" days")))
Expected uses the actual price once you know it.

=SUMIFS('Guests'!$C$6:$C$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,1)+SUMIFS('Guests'!$D$6:$D$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,1)&" people coming. "&SUMIFS('Guests'!$C$6:$C$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,3)+SUMIFS('Guests'!$D$6:$D$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,3)+SUMIFS('Guests'!$C$6:$C$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,4)+SUMIFS('Guests'!$D$6:$D$105,'Guests'!$L$6:$L$105,4)&" not sure yet. "&SUM('Guests'!$M$6:$M$105)&" thank-yous to write."
="Amounts scale with your head count: "&'Event'!$R$11&" adults and "&'Event'!$R$12&" kids. Needs are rounded up to whole items and whole packs."
Days before = how many days before the party it should be done.
